name: Cactus
hook: Soft, mushy base? Your cactus is being overwatered.

steps.title: Your sunniest window
steps.tip: Use a south or west window with several hours of direct sun all year. Run grow lights 14–16 hours a day.

steps.title: Soak, then let it dry
steps.tip: In spring and summer, water only once the soil is fully dry. In winter, give just enough to stop shriveling.

steps.title: Gritty, fast-draining mix
steps.tip: Use cactus soil, or half potting soil and half coarse sand or grit, in a pot with drainage holes.

steps.title: A cool winter rest
steps.tip: Grow it at 18–29°C. In winter, give it a cool rest at 7–13°C, away from radiators, so it sets flowers.

steps.title: Feed sparingly
steps.tip: Use a low-nitrogen cactus fertilizer at most once a month in the growing season, and none in winter.

steps.title: Repot with care
steps.tip: In spring, move up one pot size only. Wrap it in newspaper to handle it, and wait a few days to water.

outro: Lots of sun, little water, a cool winter: then come the flowers.
